prompt: Working hours are compared as an offset from midnight, and the arithmetic that turns a wall-clock time into that offset is written twice: once in internal/rules/hours.go and once as a private offset() in internal/store/doctors.go. They have already drifted (one keeps the sub-second part, the other drops it). Pull it into a single exported helper, clinic.OffsetFromMidnight(t time.Time) time.Duration, in internal/clinic, that keeps the sub-second part, and make both places use it. Pure refactor: every booking verdict and API response stays exactly as it is, and no copy of the arithmetic is left behind.
outOfScope: any change to booking verdicts, fault codes, HTTP statuses or API responses
the working-hours boundary: start bookable, end not, in the clinic zone
